patch_description: This replaces the cube-specific circuit with a permutation-equivariant collective-spin ansatz. Each block uses shared RY–RZ–RY mixers around a complete-graph CZ layer, equivalent to a discrete all-to-all one-axis twist. Because the complete entangler, collective rotations, and mean-Z readout commute with qubit relabelings, the model focuses on global pair-structure rather than index-specific artifacts. The 28 CZ gates are ordered as seven disjoint perfect matchings to limit depth. Only three parameters are used per block, reducing the total from 26 to 20 while retaining noncommuting phase-to-amplitude conversion and stronger global correlation modeling.
